readiness_model.classroom_release: Group A may support classroom release only after every Group A human decision is completed with a release-permitting outcome and all conditions satisfied, and the external classroom technical gate passes.
readiness_model.research_readiness: Research readiness requires confirmed classroom readiness, every Group B human decision completed with a research-permitting outcome and all conditions satisfied, and the external research gate passes.
